notes: Menu: Screens, Lists, Reminders and Other have new icons drawn in colour – a screen with coloured widgets on it, a notepad with a yellow top and pencil, a list with coloured lines, and four coloured tiles – so they light up properly when you’re on that page. The status dot on ↻ is a little bigger.

Home: a green ▶ Open the dashboard button at the top; which family you’re connected to and how it works are now one short box; the two green boxes are one. The Setup wizard page is one box at the top too.
⚙ Widgets → Other: the list down the left scrolls on its own, with its scroll bar always showing, so every widget is easy to reach; each widget’s settings now come first, then what it’s showing.
New: a 🎂 button on the calendar shows birthdays only, in any view (press it again for everything). There’s always a Birthday category.
New widget: Birthdays (half or full height) – the next few birthdays from the calendar; any within a week stand out in pink, and today’s is highlighted.
Phone: the calendar offers Month and Week (and opens on the week, a day under a day); ⚙ Setup → Screens’ phone picture shows the same.
